_: THE EIGHT WINDS (2026-07-28) — the identity record each diagonal prompt is built from. `who` is what the reference sheet DRAWS, read at cell magnification from reviews/eight-winds/crops/ew-town-*.png, not from the name plate (F-A8). `props` names every asymmetric prop and WHICH SIDE OF THE BODY it lives on (L/R); anim-pass-prompt.mjs turns that into the screen side for each wind. This is the whole reason a left-down walker cannot be a flipped right-down walker — and the tavernkeeper SE retake (F-EW-1) is what proved the prose form of this clause was not enough.

tavernkeeper.who: the tavernkeeper: heavyset and friendly, full dark beard, wide-brimmed weathered hat, cream shirt with rolled sleeves, long brown work apron over a vest, a pale towel draped over one shoulder, sturdy work boots

props.what: a pale towel draped over the shoulder
the apron tool pocket at the hip

storekeeper.who: the storekeeper: a trim moustached shopkeeper with short dark hair and no hat, cream shirt with rolled sleeves, a teal neckerchief knotted at the collar, a long brown leather apron over a waistcoat with crossed straps over the back, dark work trousers and boots
storekeeper.propNote: no prop survives a side assignment: the apron pocket sits on the apron FRONT and the teal neckerchief is centred at the throat. Judged on facing and identity only.

elder.who: the town elder: an old man with a full white beard, a pale wide-brimmed hat, a long fringed chevron-woven poncho worn over a waistcoat and long coat, a small teal-glowing pendant at the throat, worn boots
elder.propNote: no prop survives a side assignment: the poncho is a fringed shawl with a hem all round and the teal pendant is centred. Judged on facing and identity only — the chevron weave on the back is the identity anchor.

youngster-m.who: a young frontier boy, fully clothed, in a soft flat cap, cream shirt with rolled sleeves, a brown waistcoat over braces, work trousers and boots, carrying a small brass lantern with a teal glow

props.what: the small brass lantern with a teal glow, carried in the hand

youngster-f.who: a young frontier girl, fully clothed, in a wide-brimmed straw hat with two long braids, a tan jacket over blue denim overalls, cuffed work boots, carrying a small brass lantern with a teal glow

props.what: the small brass lantern with a teal glow, carried in the hand

newsie-mei.who: the newsie: a girl in a soft newsboy cap with a long dark braid down her back, a teal-blue jacket over a cream shirt, dark trousers and boots, a canvas satchel of folded papers on a cross-body strap, a folded paper in one hand

props.what: the canvas satchel of papers resting at the hip
the folded paper held in the hand

preacher.who: the preacher: a bearded man in a black flat-brimmed hat and a long dark frock coat over a waistcoat, a pale cravat at the throat, dark trousers and boots, carrying a small dark book

props.what: the small dark book carried in the hand

schoolteacher.who: the schoolteacher: a woman with dark curly hair pinned up, a cream blouse with full sleeves under a brown waistcoat, a dark ribbon at the throat, a long grey-brown skirt to the ankle and low boots, a small leather satchel on a shoulder strap

props.what: the leather satchel hanging at the hip
the short piece of chalk held up in the hand

assay-clerk.who: the assay clerk: a moustached man in round spectacles, cream shirt with rolled sleeves and a dark tie, a long brown work apron, dark trousers and boots

props.what: the ledger book carried in the hand
the pen held in the hand

prospector.who: the Prospector, the player's machine claim-partner: a rounded riveted brass-and-copper hovering body like a small bathysphere with a glowing teal porthole eye, a domed lamp on top, two articulated jointed arms, and a teal jet-glow plume beneath where legs would be — it has no legs and never touches the ground

props.what: the shallow brass assay pan held by the arm
the gripper claw arm

hero.who: the settler hero: a young woman in a wide-brimmed weathered hat with a long dark braid, a work shirt with rolled sleeves under an open tan leather vest, a teal stone pendant at the throat, a small leather satchel on the hip, canvas trousers cuffed into tall laced boots, carrying a shallow round metal gold pan

props.what: the shallow round metal gold pan carried in the hand
the leather satchel riding at the hip

bandit-base.who: an outlaw of the road: a wide-brimmed weathered hat, a cloth bandana pulled up over the lower face, a tattered rust-brown poncho over a worn work shirt and gloves, a plain leather strap slung across the chest, worn trousers and boots

props.what: the plain leather chest strap, which runs over the shoulder

bandit-thief.who: a lean outlaw: a wide-brimmed hat, a bandana pulled up over the lower face, a worn shirt and open vest with no poncho, a leather strap across the chest, a canvas satchel and small pouches at the belt, trousers and boots

props.what: the leather chest strap, which runs over the shoulder
the canvas satchel at the belt

baron.who: the Claim-Jumper Baron: a portly Victorian gentleman with a heavy moustache, a tall black top hat with a playing card tucked in the band, a deep maroon frock coat over a gold brocade waistcoat with a watch chain, a dark cravat, striped trousers and boots

props.what: the playing card tucked into the hatband

claim-jumper.who: a claim jumper: a stooped, hurrying scavenger in a battered tan hat and a bandana over the face, a ragged rust-orange cape over a patched shirt, a satchel and pouches at the belt, worn trousers and boots, always leaning forward

props.what: the satchel at the belt

rail-tough.who: a railway company enforcer: a bowler hat, a heavy dark beard, a long blue-grey company coat with brass shoulder pauldrons and studded bracers, a brass company badge on the chest, heavy boots, carrying a large steel wrench

props.what: the large steel wrench carried in the hand
the brass company badge on the chest

steam-wrecker.who: a steam wrecker machine: a riveted copper-and-brass boiler body like a rounded kettle with one glowing amber porthole eye, two short smokestacks venting white steam from the top, a small teal-lit gauge panel on one flank, two heavy articulated wrench-claw arms, and four squat piston legs
steam-wrecker.propNote: machine, near-symmetric: the amber eye is centred and the single teal gauge panel could not be assigned to a side from the base sheet. Judged on facing and identity only.

coal-thief.who: a coal thief: a lean hurrying figure in a worn wide-brimmed hat and a blue bandana over the face, a ragged coat with a shaggy fur collar, hoisting a big black sack of coal over one shoulder, trousers and boots, leaning forward under the weight

props.what: the big black sack of coal hoisted over the shoulder
